lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Before the armies and the challenge, David watched his father's sheep in the hills of Bethlehem.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Easy, little one. There is water here. Stay close to the flock.

lines.speaker: Messenger
lines.text: David! Jesse, your father, sends you to your brothers. Take this grain and these loaves to the camp, and the cheeses to their commander. Bring word of how your brothers are.

lines.speaker: Messenger
lines.text: I will watch the sheep. Your father is counting on you.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Keep them near the water. I will take the provisions and bring my father news.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: David left the flock with a keeper and set out for the valley of Elah. Beyond the quiet hills, two armies faced one another.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: The camp is beyond that ridge. I can hear the soldiers. I must find my brothers.
